ats_label_components.missing_policy: Empty parse is a hard issue and cannot receive high ATS score.
ats_label_components.scoring_rule: Full readable text receives high score; partial parse receives medium score; empty/scanned/unreadable parse receives low score.
ats_label_components.source_evidence: text extraction result, extracted character count, page count, parser warnings

ats_label_components.missing_policy: Unknown section headings require conservative score and review flag.
ats_label_components.scoring_rule: Score by required section coverage for target role; missing critical sections reduce score.
ats_label_components.source_evidence: detected sections such as summary, experience, education, skills, projects, certifications

ats_label_components.missing_policy: Do not store raw contact values in labels; store boolean evidence only.
ats_label_components.scoring_rule: Score by presence of reachable contact fields without exposing raw PII in labels.
ats_label_components.source_evidence: email, phone, portfolio, LinkedIn/GitHub URL evidence where available

ats_label_components.missing_policy: Unknown date formats are issues until locale-aware parsing is defined.
ats_label_components.scoring_rule: Score by parseable date coverage for experience entries and education entries.
ats_label_components.source_evidence: employment/education date ranges and duration parse evidence

ats_label_components.missing_policy: Do not invent metrics; absence is a quality issue, not a reason to generate fake evidence.
ats_label_components.scoring_rule: Score by presence and density of quantified achievements in experience/project sections.
ats_label_components.source_evidence: numbers, percentages, scale indicators, impact metrics, project outcomes in CV text

ats_label_components.missing_policy: When layout evidence is unavailable, record unknown_format_risk and keep confidence low.
ats_label_components.scoring_rule: Start from 1.0 and subtract bounded risk penalties for format patterns known to reduce ATS extraction reliability.
ats_label_components.source_evidence: parser layout signals, table density, multi-column risk, excessive graphics, file type, text order anomalies

baseline_acceptance_policy.ranking_extension: Recommendation experiments must also compare NDCG@5, NDCG@10, MAP@10, and candidate ordering examples against best ranking baseline.
baseline_acceptance_policy.selection_gate: A stronger model must improve MAE by at least 15-25% over the best valid baseline and show positive R2/Spearman before promotion beyond prototype.
baseline_acceptance_policy.slice_requirement: Report metrics by role family, language, experience band, pair type, and score band.

baseline_model_catalog.acceptance_use: Minimum sanity baseline; complex model must beat it materially.
baseline_model_catalog.fit_rule: Predict the training-set mean for every validation example.
baseline_model_catalog.leakage_control: Mean must be computed from training split only.
baseline_model_catalog.target: job_fit_label_v2 and ats_label_v1 when labels exist

baseline_model_catalog.acceptance_use: Robust constant baseline for skewed labels.
baseline_model_catalog.fit_rule: Predict the training-set median for every validation example.
baseline_model_catalog.leakage_control: Median must be computed from training split only.
baseline_model_catalog.target: job_fit_label_v2 and ats_label_v1 when labels exist

baseline_model_catalog.acceptance_use: Proves whether exact skill matching already explains labels.
baseline_model_catalog.allowed_inputs: normalized candidate skills and normalized job required skills
baseline_model_catalog.fit_rule: Predict normalized skill-overlap score directly, optionally calibrated on training split only.
baseline_model_catalog.leakage_control: No generated fit_score, profile_id, job_id, company, application outcome, or validation labels.

baseline_model_catalog.acceptance_use: Proves whether semantic text similarity beats exact skill overlap.
baseline_model_catalog.allowed_inputs: profile/CV text embedding and job text embedding from versioned text construction
baseline_model_catalog.fit_rule: Predict clipped cosine similarity or train-only calibrated cosine score.
baseline_model_catalog.leakage_control: Embedding text must exclude labels, wrapper summaries, and hydrated recommendation details.

baseline_model_catalog.acceptance_use: Best transparent comparator before neural scorer or feature-augmented scorer.
baseline_model_catalog.allowed_inputs: documented scalar features: skill overlap, cosine, experience gap, role match, requirement coverage, ATS component scores
baseline_model_catalog.fit_rule: Fit linear/ridge regression or logistic-style band model on training split only with fixed random seed.
baseline_model_catalog.leakage_control: Features must be generated before manual validation labels are inspected; no identifiers or product copy.
baseline_model_catalog.target: job_fit_label_v2 and optional ats_label_v1 with separate feature sets

blocked_until_later_phases: Phase 3 must define normalization rules before labels are generated.
Phase 4 must generate balanced pairs with leakage-safe splits before baseline evaluation.
Phase 5 must run this baseline catalog before model training.
Phase 7 must build controlled ATS benchmark samples before production ATS claims.
Phase 10 must calibrate score bands before production score semantics are finalized.

inputs.phase_scope: Phase 2 — Label Schema and Baseline Definitions

jobfit_label_components.leakage_control: Do not use fit_score, profile_id, job_id, company name, bookmarked/applied status, or validation labels.
jobfit_label_components.missing_policy: Record empty_skills flag and use 0.0 until skill extraction is fixed.
jobfit_label_components.scoring_rule: Jaccard-style exact overlap after Phase 3 skill normalization; score 0 when either side has no reliable skill evidence.
jobfit_label_components.source_evidence: normalized profile/CV skills and normalized job requirements skills

jobfit_label_components.leakage_control: Build text from source profile/CV/job fields only, not generated summaries or labels.
jobfit_label_components.missing_policy: Record empty_text flag and use 0.0 if either text side is empty after parsing.
jobfit_label_components.scoring_rule: Cosine similarity scaled to 0.0-1.0 after text construction policy is versioned.
jobfit_label_components.source_evidence: profile/CV text embedding and job text embedding

jobfit_label_components.leakage_control: Do not infer seniority from target label or post-hoc model prediction.
jobfit_label_components.missing_policy: Record unknown_experience flag and use neutral 0.5 only for label drafting; Phase 3 must replace silent fallback with explicit unknown handling.
jobfit_label_components.scoring_rule: Score 1.0 for exact or above-minimum match, degrade by bounded gap size, score 0.0 for clear underqualification beyond allowed tolerance.
jobfit_label_components.source_evidence: normalized candidate experience and normalized job seniority/experience requirement

jobfit_label_components.leakage_control: Role family taxonomy must be derived before split labels are reviewed.
jobfit_label_components.missing_policy: Record unknown_role flag and use neutral 0.5 only when no role evidence exists.
jobfit_label_components.scoring_rule: Exact role-family match receives high score, adjacent role-family receives medium score, unrelated role receives low score.
jobfit_label_components.source_evidence: normalized job title/category and candidate target role/profile title/CV headline when available

jobfit_label_components.leakage_control: Requirement coverage cannot use wrapper-generated topActionables or sectionReviews.
jobfit_label_components.missing_policy: Record empty_requirements flag and exclude missing job requirements from denominator instead of rewarding unknown data.
jobfit_label_components.scoring_rule: Covered required evidence divided by required evidence count, with critical requirements allowed to carry higher local weight.
jobfit_label_components.source_evidence: job requirement summary, required skills, CV/profile evidence, and extracted project/experience claims

ats_sampling.sampling_rule: Use controlled benchmark files and real/synthetic CVs with documented license/consent; keep raw PII out of labels.

job_fit_sampling.sampling_rule: Sample from locked validation/test groups after split assignment; include high-fit positives, medium-fit adjacent cases, hard negatives, and random negatives.

label_manifest.storage_policy: Store review IDs, split name, band, role family, language, pair type, anonymized evidence pointers, reviewer labels, and adjudication status. Do not store raw contact PII.

leakage_controls: Manual labels cannot be used during Phase 3 normalization decisions for the same validation examples.
Training code must ignore manual-review columns unless a later label version intentionally includes them.
Group isolation by profile_id must remain intact after manual sampling.
No wrapper-generated topActionables, sectionReviews, or hydrated job details may enter labels.
Reviewer notes are qualitative audit data, not model features.
review_workflow: Freeze candidate IDs, split names, and source artifact hashes before review.
Give reviewers only source evidence needed for the label, not model prediction internals or future validation labels.
Use two independent reviewers for calibration subset and adjudicate disagreements.
Record inter-reviewer agreement before changing label schema or score bands.
Publish aggregate validation report without exposing raw CV contact data.

optional_jobfit_components.leakage_control: Never hydrate job details from static model artifacts; backend owns visibility, freshness, and final job detail.
optional_jobfit_components.missing_policy: Do not penalize when preferences are absent; keep outside core jobFitAlignment label.
optional_jobfit_components.scoring_rule: Use only as candidate-reranking metadata or bounded preference score after backend contract approval.
optional_jobfit_components.source_evidence: backend-provided user preferences such as location, work type, employment type, salary range, and candidate set constraints

score_band_policy.product_meaning_ats: CV has serious parseability, structure, contact/date, metric, or formatting issues that can block reliable screening.
score_band_policy.product_meaning_jobfit: Major skill, role, experience, or requirement gaps. User should treat the role as aspirational or needing substantial preparation.
score_band_policy.training_requirement: Pair generation must include true low cases and hard negatives, not only random weak pairs.

score_band_policy.product_meaning_ats: CV is mostly parseable but has issues that can reduce ranking or hide important evidence.
score_band_policy.product_meaning_jobfit: Partial match with clear strengths and visible gaps. User may apply after targeted improvements.
score_band_policy.training_requirement: Pair generation must include adjacent-role and partial-skill cases, not only extremes.

score_band_policy.product_meaning_ats: CV is parseable, structured, contact/date evidence is detectable, and formatting risk is low.
score_band_policy.product_meaning_jobfit: Strong match with most critical evidence present. Remaining gaps should be specific and actionable.
score_band_policy.training_requirement: Validation and training splits must contain high-fit/high-quality examples before any model can claim full-range scoring.

score_policy_notes.current_snapshot_warning: Legacy weak labels had no high-fit samples above the high-band threshold, so Phase 4 must create balanced pairs before training.
score_policy_notes.phase_10_requirement: Replace or confirm these thresholds only after calibration diagnostics and score-bucket error are reported.
